result.summary: Overall layout looks mostly fine; one minor issue found with the 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant name being clipped within its card rather than at the screen edge.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' and its delivery time/price info is not fully visible, though the card itself is not at the very edge of the horizontally scrollable row.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncates with an ellipsis or the card width accommodates the full restaurant name for better readability.
